name: Physlib Review Report: Reviewed 23 pull requests on electromagnetism, classical mechanics, space and time, and tensors
description: Physlib Contribution Report on work by Zhi Kai Pong: “Reviewed 23 pull requests on electromagnetism, classical mechanics, space and time, and tensors”.

issuer.name: Physlib Contributions
issuer.description: An open-source community project to digitalize results from physics into Lean 4. Physlib Contributions publishes signed reports on reviewing, maintenance, refactoring, foundations, formalisation and documentation of Physlib.

credentialSubject.narrative: Reviewed pull requests to Physlib over a year, mainly on electromagnetism, vector calculus, classical mechanics, space and time, and tensors. The reviews checked definitions against the physics, suggested names and statements closer to Mathlib conventions, proposed simpler proofs and more uniform designs, and guided new contributors through the project's conventions.

achievement.name: Physlib Review Report
achievement.description: For reviewing pull requests (proposed changes) to Physlib: checking that definitions match the physics, suggesting better statements or proofs, and helping authors get their work merged.

criteria.narrative:
- The reviews were on pull requests to leanprover-community/physlib and contained substantive comments, not only approvals.
- The reviews improved the physics, the Lean code or the documentation of the change.
- Links to the reviewed pull requests or review threads are given as evidence.
